verdict:
NO ENTRY - the discount is correct on the company's own numbers.

THE SCREEN PREMISE IS VOID. EVH is tagged 'Consumer Discretionary / Other Consumer Services'; it is a healthcare specialty-care-management company (CIK 1628908, oncology/cardiology capitation sold to health plans). The excess_dd vs the Consumer Discretionary median carries no information. The blob was also stale: mcap $444M vs ~$529M current, dd52 -0.61 vs pack -0.536 - the sweep measured a drawdown that had already retraced 123% off the $2.095 low by triage time. Both defects go to the screen, not the name.

WHY THE DISCOUNT IS RIGHT. The triage's STRUCTURAL call rests on management's own arithmetic, and it is the honest read: a $150M revenue guide RAISE carried only $2.5M of EBITDA (1.7% incremental margin); the 2027 frame - +25% revenue, adj-EBITDA 'at or above $150M' - concedes a <=4.5% margin business at ~$3.3B of revenue; net debt ~$808M against $120-135M of guided FY26 EBITDA is ~6.3x; H1 OCF was negative $10.3M. A $529M market cap on $2.65B of revenue is a thin equity stub priced as a thin equity stub. The Q2 MER spike (95.3% vs 84.9% ex-ECP LY) has an honest bull rebuttal - conservative Highmark-launch reserving that releases if the cohort develops favorably - but even granting it fully, the bull case is a 4.5%-margin 6x-levered risk-bearing business. Mitigants stated fairly: no maturity wall before Jan-2029, and the preferred was exchanged into second-lien debt with no common conversion, so the share count is real.

THE ONE DATUM THAT WOULD REOPEN THIS, AND NOBODY HAS READ IT. The Q2-26 10-Q's claims-reserve rollforward line 'incurred related to prior years' adjudicates conservative-launch-reserving vs real-cost-trend in a single number. The triage could not fetch it (SEC 403, no shell; accession 0001628908-26-000086 already filed). That is a one-fetch coverage item, not a court. If it shows materially favorable prior-year development, the 95.3% MER is partly an artifact and the 2027 >=$150M path becomes a genuine dispersion question - re-score to 6-7 and convene benches then.

DAMAGE-ABSENT CHECK: fails by definition - the predicted damage (margin/leverage) is present, named, and quantified in the 8/6 print. Demand is genuinely unimpaired (rev +47%, a 1.5M-life oncology launch adding ~$300M annualized in December), but that launch ADDS unpriced capitated risk into the next two quarters, which cuts against entry, not for it.
blue_ruling: TRIAGE-ONLY - no benches convened. Court-worthiness 4/10, well below threshold, and I concur: the discount is over-determined by management's own guidance arithmetic, and the single open question is resolved by one filing read, not by an adversarial court.
reopen_gates: DATA (one fetch, do it before anything else): the Q2-26 10-Q claims rollforward, accession 0001628908-26-000086 - the 'incurred related to prior years' line. Materially FAVORABLE prior-year development = the MER spike is launch-reserving conservatism; re-score court-worthiness to 6-7 and convene benches on the 2027 >=$150M EBITDA path. Adverse or neutral development = the AVOID stands and hardens.
DATA: two consecutive quarters of positive operating cash flow - the stub is only investable if the risk book generates cash, not adjusted EBITDA.
EVENT: deleveraging below ~4x net debt/EBITDA via asset sale or equity-friendly refinancing - changes the stub arithmetic more than any operating quarter can.

EVENT: December-2026 oncology launch (~$300M annualized, 1.5M lives) survives its first two quarters without an MER deterioration - the launch is currently un-priced risk; two clean quarters convert it to growth.
